intent: Implement ValidatedSampleStream (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation. Outbound port of the bounded, backpressure-aware validated sample event stream (customer-supplier link to History). Overflow posture is ERROR with a declared reason; consumer is the pipeline subscription (PipelineSubscriber). Imports only reactor and java.*.

methods.semantics: Completes when the event is accepted by the bounded buffer; emits IllegalStateException when the buffer is full (overflow posture ERROR) - the false path is an error, never a silent drop.
Hot fan-out of published events, consumed by PipelineSubscriber.
